user.title: Connect to Webtop
user.description: Sign in with the same username and password you use at webtop.smartschool.co.il. A parent login sees every linked child.

data_description.data: Leave empty. The integration computes the 'Data' value of the login request from your username. Fill this in only to force a value captured from the browser.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Webtop server. Check the connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Webtop rejected the login. Check the username and password by signing in at webtop.smartschool.co.il.
error.captcha_required: Webtop is asking for a captcha before it accepts a password login from this network. Sign in once in a browser, wait a while, then try again.
error.too_many_attempts: Webtop locked this account after too many failed attempts. Wait, or reset the password on the portal.
error.unknown: Unexpected error; see the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Webtop account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: Those credentials belong to a different Webtop account.

data_description.scan_interval: Minutes between polls of the Webtop portal.
